notes.title: Version 2.1 is out!
notes.notes:
Version 2.1 is finally out! We took advantage of a delay for the physical cartridge edition to add a lot of contents to the game, and the ROM is now filled to the brim!

So what's new?


Alternate ball styles and player costumes (Initially 4 ball colors and 2 colors per player) to fit your style! (Chosen at the baller select screen)
Rogueball! Choose your path across each floor, raise your stats, unlock treasures, and survive as long as you can!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44119666/1062a2621b0b7ced94fb05461cbe15e69b35174d.png
Treasures! Additional ball styles and player skins (colors, custume, shadow) can be unlocked by opening chests in Rogueball. Total of 8 extra balls and 16 skins to unlock!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44119666/b546222ae0dab733859578fca557272d23005327.png
New 2 player modes: Purist (no items) and Moonballer (slow ball as in bonuses) for additional fun!
Added a second high scores table specific to Rogueball, to track your exploits!
Steam leaderboards (for Competition and Rogueball scores) can now be viewed from within the game. (Access Show High Scores from the Options menu)


Note: Alternate balls and player skins do not affect gameplay - they simply look great and are fun!
